duration.text: The Biological Technology at Ocean University of China is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese/English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3194 USD/per year ￥ 23000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of undergraduate school 5.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6.CV( in Chinese or English) 7.Study Plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief.

requirements.text: 1. Be in good health 2. Hold a Bachelor's degree and pass the entrance examination conducted by the Ocean University of China
